Brave and Marginalia HTML are the saved response samples from the legacy discovery tests.
Mwmbl and Wikipedia retain the legacy parser test response shapes; arXiv retains its
legacy sample with the real Atom namespace added. Hacker News and Stack Exchange are
saved synthetic API responses covering their former transformations. SearXNG and
DuckDuckGo are synthetic protocol/markup samples, not evidence of live availability.
No fixture test makes network requests.
